description_en: Calls GetJobDetail to retrieve the details of a Spark job
description_zh: 调用GetJobDetail获取Spark作业的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun openanalytics-open get-job-detail --job-id j202010271622hangzhouf742a4330000923 --vc-name MyCluster --api-version 2018-06-19 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetJobDetail

parameters.help_en: The name of the virtual cluster that runs the Spark job
parameters.help_zh: 执行Spark作业的虚拟集群名称
parameters.name: vc_name

JobDetail.description_en: The details of the Spark job

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the Spark job started to run. The time zone is the time zone of the region where the job runs
CreateTime.description_zh: Spark作业开始执行的时间，时区为执行区域的时区

CreateTimeValue.description_en: The timestamp in milliseconds when the Spark job started to run
CreateTimeValue.description_zh: Spark作业开始执行的毫秒级时间戳

Detail.description_en: The JSON string that defines the Spark job

DriverResourceSpec.description_en:
The compute resource specifications of the driver. Valid values:

small: 1 core, 4 GB

medium: 2 cores, 8 GB

large: 4 cores, 16 GB

xlarge: 8 cores, 32 GB
DriverResourceSpec.description_zh:
Driver计算资源规格。取值范围：

small：1Core 4GB

medium：2Core 8GB

large：4Core 16GB

xlarge：8Core 32GB

ExecutorInstances.description_en: The number of executors for the Spark job

ExecutorResourceSpec.description_en:
The compute resource specifications of the executor. Valid values:

small: 1 core, 4 GB

medium: 2 cores, 8 GB

large: 4 cores, 16 GB

xlarge: 8 cores, 32 GB
ExecutorResourceSpec.description_zh:
Executor计算资源规格。取值范围：

small：1Core 4GB

medium：2Core 8GB

large：4Core 16GB

xlarge：8Core 32GB

JobId.description_en: The ID of the Spark job

JobName.description_en: The name of the Spark job

LastJobAttemptId.description_en: The ID of the most recent attempt to run the Spark job
LastJobAttemptId.description_zh: 最近一次尝试执行的Spark作业ID

SparkUI.description_en: The Spark UI of the Spark job. For more information, see [Configure Spark UI]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163470.html）
SparkUI.description_zh: Spark作业的UI，具体请参考[配置Spark UI]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163470.html）

Status.description_en: The status code of the Spark job

SubmitTime.description_en: The time when the Spark job was submitted. The time zone is the time zone of the region where the job runs
SubmitTime.description_zh: 提交Spark作业的时间，时区为执行区域的时区

SubmitTimeValue.description_en: The timestamp in milliseconds when the Spark job was submitted
SubmitTimeValue.description_zh: 提交Spark作业的毫秒级时间戳

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the Spark job status was last updated. The time zone is the time zone of the region where the job runs
UpdateTime.description_zh: 最后一次更新Spark作业状态的时间，时区为执行作业区域的时区

UpdateTimeValue.description_en: The timestamp in milliseconds when the Spark job status was last updated
UpdateTimeValue.description_zh: 最后一次更新Spark作业状态的毫秒级时间戳

VcName.description_en: The name of the virtual cluster that runs the Spark job
VcName.description_zh: 执行Spark作业的虚拟集群名称

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
